# Mailcoach

Mailcoach is an email marketing platform that allows users to manage email campaigns and subscriber lists efficiently.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mailcoach/.

## Actions

- **Add Email List**: Create a new email list.
- **Add Mailcoach Campaign**: Create a new mailcoach campaign.
- **Add Tag to Email List**: Create a new tag within a specific email list.
- **Add Template**: Create a new email template.
- **Confirm Subscriber**: Confirm a subscriber’s subscription.
- **Get All Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve all campaigns.
- **Get All Sent Items** (read-only): Retrieve all sent items.
- **Get All Subscriber Imports** (read-only): Retrieve all subscriber imports.
- **Get All Suppressions** (read-only): List all suppression entries.
- **Get All Tags** (read-only): Retrieve all tags for a specific email list.
- **Get Email Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all email lists.
- **Get Specific Campaign** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific mailcoach campaign.
- **Get Specific Subscriber** (read-only): Retrieve a specific subscriber.
- **Remove Tags from Subscriber**: Remove tags from a subscriber.
- **Resend Subscriber Confirmation**: Resend confirmation email to a subscriber.
- **Start Subscriber Import**: Start processing a subscriber import.
- **Subscribe To Email List**: Add or update a subscriber in an email list.
- **Unsubscribe Subscriber**: Unsubscribe a subscriber from an email list.
- **Update Campaign**: Update an existing mailcoach campaign.
- **Update Email List**: Update an existing email list.
- **Update Subscriber**: Update a subscriber.
- **Add suppression**: Add a suppression entry.
- **Add Tags to Subscriber**: Add tags to a subscriber.
- **Add Transactional Email Template**: Create a new template that can be used for transactional emails.
- **Append to Subscriber Import**: Append csv data to an existing subscriber import.
- **Create Subscriber Import**: Create a new subscriber import.
- **Delete Campaign**: Delete a campaign by uuid.
- **Delete Email List**: Delete an email list by uuid.
- **Delete Send**: Delete a sent item by its uuid.
- **Delete Subscriber**: Delete a subscriber by uuid.
- **Delete Subscriber Import**: Delete a subscriber import by its uuid.
- **Delete Suppression**: Delete a suppression entry by uuid.
- **Delete Tag from Email List**: Delete a tag from an email list.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a template by uuid.
- **Delete Transactional Mail**: Delete a transactional mail by its uuid.
- **Get All Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all templates.
- **Get All Transactional Email Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all transactional email templates.
- **Get Specific Email List** (read-only): Retrieve a specific email list.
- **Get Specific Suppression** (read-only): Retrieve a specific suppression entry.
- **Get Specific Tag** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific tag.
- **Get Specific Template** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific template.
- **Get Transactional Mails** (read-only): Retrieve all transactional mail templates.
- **Update Subscriber Import**: Update an existing subscriber import.
- **Update Tag**: Update an existing tag within an email list.
- **Update Template**: Update an existing template's name or content.
